N total sequences

span.p:
1.1: Parse BOLD TSV
Validate required columns
processid, nuc, species

span.p:
1.2: Mark Coordinate Quality
Flag: has_centroid_coords
Flag: has_missing_coords
Calc: is_geographic_quality

span.p:

Spatial join lat,lon → GOaS
Only samples with is_geographic_quality=TRUE

X with ocean basins, Y as Unknown

Try forward + rev complement
Select best ORF coverage
Genetic code: 2 vertebrate mito

span.p:

Length: ≥200bp AND ≥70% median
N content: ≤5%

3.1: Multiple Sequence Alignment
MAFFT auto algorithm

span.p:

Mask columns with >50% gaps

span.p:
3.3: Core Region Extraction
Positions with ≥80% coverage
Min core length: 150bp

span.p:
3.4: Identify ESVs
Group by 100% identity in core
Each unique sequence = 1 haplotype

span.p:
3.5: Singleton Error Filter
Calculate nearest-neighbor distance
REMOVE singletons ≤0.5% divergent

Use exact assignments from Phase 3
No distance-based re-assignment
No ties all exact matches

If ≥70% agree → species
Else → genus or ambiguous
